2608.14452.title: SheetCompass: Hierarchical Relation Graphs for Agentic Spreadsheet Reasoning
2608.14452.paper_summary: Spreadsheets are widely used to organize, analyze, and manipulate semi-structured data, yet automated spreadsheet reasoning remains challenging for large language models (LLMs). Real-world workbooks often contain implicit cross-table associations, fine-grained column dependencies, and complex spatial layouts. Existing methods typically flatten these multidimensional structures into sequential strings, losing important intra-sheet boundaries and inter-sheet semantics. Consequently, LLMs cannot exploit the global spatial context that human experts naturally use when inspecting spreadsheets. We propose SheetCompass, a graph-guided and memory-driven agentic framework for spreadsheet reasoning and automation. SheetCompass explicitly models structural relationships within and across worksheets while maintaining task-relevant information in memory, enabling agents to reason more effectively over complex workbooks.
2608.14452.paper_summary_zh: 電子表格被廣泛用於組織、分析和處理半結構化數據，但對於大型語言模型（LLMs）來說，自動化的電子表格推理仍然具有挑戰性。現實世界的工作簿通常包含隱含的跨表關聯、細粒度的列依賴性和複雜的空間佈局。現有方法通常將這些多維結構展平為序列字符串，從而丟失了重要的內表邊界和跨表語義。因此，LLMs無法利用人類專家在檢查電子表格時自然使用的全局空間上下文。我們提出了SheetCompass，一個基於圖形引導和記憶驅動的電子表格推理與自動化代理框架。SheetCompass明確建模工作表內部和之間的結構關係，同時在記憶中保持與任務相關的信息，使代理能夠更有效地對複雜的工作簿進行推理。
